label: Present Continuous for future
outcome: Lo studente usa il Present Continuous per accordi futuri già organizzati e distingue questo uso da un'azione che sta accadendo adesso.
must_master: future questions and negatives when natural
distinguish arrangement from action happening now
do_not_teach_yet: advanced timetable use of Present Simple
going to as the main target

italian_learner_risks.risk: using Present Continuous without a future context
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: I'm meeting Luca. interpreted without context
italian_learner_risks.target: I'm meeting Luca at six tomorrow.

italian_learner_risks.risk: confusing a vague intention with an organised arrangement
italian_learner_risks.example_wrong: using an arrangement form when no concrete arrangement exists
italian_learner_risks.target: require a booking, time, place, person or equivalent organisational detail

quality_rejections: future use without enough future context
tomorrow as the only reason for the answer
repeating Present Continuous basic form without future meaning
